caption: Dolphin call confirmed by ear (D. Edgington), July 31 2015 23:30 UTC, the final night of the first MARS deployment month. Flagged as a sub-threshold orca_call candidate and reviewed as part of the July 2015 orca screen, which found zero orca. Mel/viridis, 5 s window with 30 s context; the 30 s view shows a broadband click-rich background.
command: nohup python3 phase2_classify.py review --db-dir /mnt/PAM_Analysis/perch-hoplite/db/MARS_20150728_20150731_32kHz_norm --classifier /mnt/PAM_Analysis/perch-hoplite/models/orca_v10.pt --target-label orca_call --detections-csv /mnt/PAM_Analysis/perch-hoplite/results/review_jul2015_orca_ge050.csv --detections-offset 0 --num-results 6 --classes orca_call,humpback_song,dolphin_call,ship_noise,other,unlabeled --annotator-id duane --audio-dir /mnt/PAM_Analysis/GoogleMultiSpeciesWhaleModel2/resampled_32kHz/2015/07 --spectrogram-type mel --colormap viridis --serve --port 7878
notes: Label #6, wid=20726. Displayed score 0.711 is the orca_v4 score: the review CSV was built from the v4 detections (the superset at >=0.5), while the session ran --classifier orca_v10.pt. orca_v10 scored this window BELOW 0.5 -- it is absent from v10's >=0.5 set entirely, so this is a window v10 largely dismissed that proved to be a real dolphin call by ear. Relevant to dolphin_call recall in v10, not to orca performance.
